item.title: Carriageway and Footway Surface Defects 2021 source files
item.subtitle: Transport / DfI, Roads NI
item.description: Every recorded surface defect (potholes, cracks, ruts, surface damage) on Northern Ireland's public roads and footways during 2021, with division/section/response-time attributes. ~124 K point records — DfI's authoritative road-condition survey for that year.
